observations: Photo shows multiple used tyres stacked closely, with tread pattern visible.
Tread appears to have grooves and sipes (looks like a winter/all-season style tread), but exact tyre size/brand is not readable.
No clear sidewall markings (brand/model/size/UTQG) are readable in the provided image.
No photo of tyre DOT date, sidewall cracks, bulges, punctures, or uneven wear.

claims.evidence: No sidewall/DOT/brand-size markings are readable in photo 0 to confirm origin (tokunbo) or exact tyre details.

risks.risk: Tyre size (width/aspect/rim) is unknown, so it may not fit the buyer’s vehicle.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the tyre sidewall showing the full size marking (e.g., 195/65R15) and brand/model if present.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used tyre (worst-case: may be the wrong size), so treat as low value until size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Remaining tread depth is unknown; tyres could be near-worn out despite visible tread.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the tread with a ruler/coin for scale, plus a shot of the wear bars (tread wear indicators).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed good tread (worst-case: low remaining tread), so value is reduced until tread depth is shown.

risks.risk: Age/DOT date is unknown; older tyres can be unsafe even if tread looks okay.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the DOT code on the sidewall (week/year).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as older/unknown age (worst-case: aged), so value is reduced until DOT is confirmed.

risks.risk: Damage/defects (sidewall cracks, bulges, punctures, patch repairs) are not visible from the current angle.
risks.proof: Photos of each tyre’s sidewall and both shoulders, plus a close-up of any repaired areas or visible cracks/bulges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing inspection (worst-case: may have hidden damage), so value is reduced until defects are ruled out.

risks.risk: Quantity and whether tyres are all the same size/condition is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full stack with labels, or a list showing number of tyres and their sizes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as mixed/uncertain quantity/condition (worst-case: not uniform), so value is reduced until confirmed.

proof_requests: Send a clear sidewall photo showing the full tyre size (e.g., 195/65R15) and brand/model if present.
Send a photo of the DOT date (week/year) for at least one tyre from the stack.
Send close-ups of tread wear indicators (wear bars) and tread depth with a ruler/coin for scale.
Send photos of sidewalls/shoulders for cracks, bulges, punctures, and any patch repairs.
response.reason: The photo shows used tyres but the key pricing drivers (exact size/brand and DOT/tread condition) are not readable. Without those, a worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
